name: OmarchySS
author: DocwatZ
description: A Spotify-aware terminal screensaver with configurable TTFX effects.

barWidget.description: Launch a configurable terminal screensaver with Spotify controls.

schema.label: Screensaver text
schema.description: Track shows the current Spotify artist and title.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Used when Screensaver text is Custom.

schema.label: Auto-close after seconds
schema.description: Set to 0 to keep the screensaver open until stopped.

schema.label: Beat-reactive effects
schema.description: Use Cava audio peaks to advance TTFX effects. Requires cava.

schema.label: Terminal font size
schema.description: Increase this if the screensaver text is too small.

schema.label: Render text as FIGlet art
schema.description: Turns the screensaver text into large ASCII/Unicode block art before animating it. Requires figlet and a local .flf font file.

schema.label: FIGlet font file (.flf)
schema.description: Absolute path to a local FIGlet font, e.g. ~/.local/share/omarchyss/fonts/Delta Corps Priest 1.flf
